title: Splendours of Sri Lanka: Kandy, Nuwara Eliya and Mirissa
alt: Coconut Tree Hill above Mirissa beach at sunset
transport: Private air conditioned car with an English speaking chauffeur guide throughout

stops.name: Kandy
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Standard class hotel on the Mahaweli river outside Kandy

activities.name: Private visit to Pinnawala
activities.description: A stop on the way up from the airport to watch the resident herd bathe in the Maha Oya river and feed at the sanctuary.

activities.name: Private lake drive and Kandyan dance show
activities.description: An evening circuit of the lake followed by a traditional performance of drummers, masked dancers and the closing fire walk.

program.name: Kandy
program.description: One night by the river at Kandy with a private elephant visit on the way and a private lake drive and dance show.

stops.name: Nuwara Eliya
stops.hotel: Tea Mount Forest Hotel, Nuwara Eliya
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Standard class hotel set among the tea gardens

activities.name: Private half day Kandy sightseeing
activities.description: The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, the giant Bahiravokanda Buddha above the town and the Royal Botanical Gardens at Peradeniya.

program.name: Nuwara Eliya
program.description: A private half day of Kandy, then up into the tea country for a night in Little England.

stops.name: Bentota
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Standard class beach resort on the Bentota shore

activities.name: Private full day Nuwara Eliya sightseeing
activities.description: Ramboda Falls, a working tea estate and factory, Gregory Lake, Victoria Park, Hakgala gardens and the Seetha Amman temple.

activities.name: Private excursion to Mirissa and Galle
activities.description: South along the coast to the Dutch fort at Galle with its ramparts and lighthouse, then on to Mirissa beach and Coconut Tree Hill.

program.name: Bentota
program.description: A private full day of Nuwara Eliya on the way down, then two nights on the beach with a private excursion to Mirissa and Galle.

stops.name: Colombo
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 4★ · Four star hotel on the Mount Lavinia beachfront south of the city

activities.name: Private full day Colombo sightseeing
activities.description: Galle Face Green, the Gangaramaya temple, the colonial Fort district, the Lotus Tower and the floating market at Pettah.

program.name: Colombo
program.description: A final night on the Mount Lavinia beachfront with a private full day of the capital.

1: Arrival at Bandaranaike International and private transfer inland
A stop at the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary on the way
Check in at your Kandy hotel in the afternoon
An evening lake drive and the Kandyan dance performance
2: Breakfast, then the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
The hilltop Buddha at Bahiravokanda and Peradeniya gardens
A transfer through the tea estates to Nuwara Eliya
Check in and an evening walk by Gregory Lake
3: Breakfast, then Ramboda Falls and a tea factory visit
Gregory Lake, Victoria Park and the Hakgala gardens
The Seetha Amman temple of the Ramayana trail
A long transfer down to Bentota and check in at the beach

Mirissa beach and the palms of Coconut Tree Hill
The Galle Dutch fort: ramparts, lighthouse and old church

expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Kandy, the hills and then the coast. Sri Lanka works best when you let the island cool you down before it warms you up again.
expert.tip: Carry a light sweater for Nuwara Eliya. It sits at nearly 1,900 metres and evenings are surprisingly chilly even in April.

summary: Six days with everything in: a night in Kandy with the elephants and the dance show, a night in the tea country, two nights at Bentota with a private day at Mirissa and Galle, and a last night in Colombo.
included: Included: 5 nights in standard and deluxe class hotels with breakfast and lunch or dinner daily; private airport transfers and all road travel in an air conditioned car with chauffeur guide; private Pinnawala visit; private Kandy lake drive and dance show; private half day Kandy sightseeing; private full day Nuwara Eliya sightseeing; a private excursion to Mirissa and Galle; private full day Colombo sightseeing. Entrance tickets are payable locally.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; lunches unless stated; entrance tickets where marked as payable locally; travel insurance; optional excursions; tips and personal expenses.
